assertions.subject: Long QT syndrome
assertions.quote: The risk of sudden cardiac death (SCD) in Long QT syndrome depends on age, sex, and QTc interval duration and ranges from 15 to 70%.

assertions.subject: Long QT syndrome

assertions.quote: patients with QT syndrome who have had a previous syncope episode may not elicit VT on programmed electrical stimulation of EP study.

assertions.subject: Long QT syndrome

assertions.subject: Long QT syndrome
assertions.quote: the presence of NSVT has no prognostic value in identifying high-risk patients for future SCD.

assertions.subject: Long QT syndrome

assertions.subject: Short QT syndrome
assertions.quote: These are congenital channelopathies with QTc <330ms associated with an increased risk of malignant ventricular arrhythmias leading to cardiac arrest.
